messages.アイアンメイデンと、回避「始まった展示会」以外の全スキルが持つ出血回数増加で敵の: A Charge and Bleed Identity that sustains enemy Bleed Count through Iron Maiden and Count increases on every skill except the evade, The Exhibition Begins. Build the special Charge, Corpus Ingredient, to 3 Potency to increase Bleed application and expand S3's area after releasing restraints.
messages.生体材料: 特殊充電(回数最大20)。登場時に(戦場にいる薬指所属の味方数×2): **Corpus Ingredient**: A special Charge with up to 20 Count. When she first appears, its Count increases by (number of Ring allies on the field×2), up to 10. At the end of a skill that dealt damage to HP or Shield, +5 Count, plus +3 more if it defeated the target. Each time she spends a cumulative 10 Count, she gains 1 Corpus Ingredient Potency.
messages.作品名:ファシア: 生体材料の威力2以上で得る。威力1で基本威力+1、2で出血の: **Artwork: Fascia**: Gained at 2 or more Corpus Ingredient Potency. At Potency 1, +1 Base Power; at 2, +10% damage against enemies with Bleed; at 3, +1 to the Bleed Potency and Count she inflicts; at 4, +1 Base Power.
messages.アイアンメイデン(序盤): 最も左のスロットの挑発値+4。ターン開始時に保護1・: **Iron Maiden (early phase)**: +4 Aggro on her leftmost slot. At Turn Start, she gains 1 Protection, 5 Defense Level Up, and Shield. When she takes damage from an attacker's final Coin, she returns 20% of it as Pierce damage and increases the attacker's Bleed Count by 2, once per skill and up to 3 times per turn. At Turn End on the turn she gains Fascia, she switches to The Self Unbound - Flow State, gaining +2 to her minimum and maximum Speed and swapping her skills.
messages.S3「抑圧された肉体」/「抑圧された肉体の解放」: 回数10以上なら最大20まで: **S3 Repressed Flesh / Liberation of the Repressed Flesh**: With at least 10 Count, spends up to 20 for +2 Final Power and more damage. After The Self Unbound, the skill gains +1/+2 Attack Weight at 3/5 or more Corpus Ingredient, and all of its Coins become Unbreakable Coins.
messages.解除後の守備「始まった展示会」: 戦闘開始時に援護防御1を得て、一方攻撃される味: **Defense skill after The Self Unbound — The Exhibition Begins**: At Combat Start, gains 1 Assist Defense, then covers an ally who is attacked one-sidedly and counters with No Acts of Vandalism Allowed., a clashable counter that spends and gains Corpus Ingredient.
messages.サポートパッシブ「アイアンメイデン-棘」(色欲×1・嫉妬×2・保有・同期化Ⅲで取: **Support passive — Iron Maiden - Spikes (1 Lust and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When an ally with a Defense skill equipped takes damage, inflicts 4 Bleed on the attacker. If the attacker already has Bleed, increases Bleed Count by 2 instead, twice per turn.
messages.序盤はアイアンメイデンの耐久と挑発値で攻撃を受け、出血回数を伸ばしながら生体材料: Early on, absorb attacks with Iron Maiden's durability and Aggro, extending Bleed Count while building Corpus Ingredient Count. Use S3 only after checking whether its spending will reach 3 Potency; do not throw it away early. After The Self Unbound, attack with her basic skills, which now inflict more Bleed, and her multi-target S3, and use her Defense skill's Assist Defense to cover allies and counterattack. This counter is strong against enemies with Unbreakable Coins. Her support passive is powerful, so leaving her in backup is also an option. She has strong synergy with Hong Lu's The House of Spiders: The Ring Nursefather.
